item.title: Approval under Section 153D of the Income Tax Act must reflect application of mind: Bombay High Court dismisses Revenue’s appeal
item.description: “An order, which does not reflect even minimum application of mind, cannot be saved by filing an affidavit claiming that there was material based upon which such approval could have been granted.” The post Approval under Section 153D of the Income Tax Act must reflect application of mind: Bombay High Court dismisses Revenue’s appeal appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Mandatory ESIC Registration Under Social Security Code, 2020: Compliance before 31st Dec 2025
item.description: ESIC issued circular making registration under Social Security Code, 2020 mandatory for all establishments by 31-12-2025. The post Mandatory ESIC Registration Under Social Security Code, 2020: Compliance before 31st Dec 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: AAI cannot unilaterally shut Airport multiplex; Madras HC orders National Policy Review by Centre
item.description: “Any landing and taking off area for aircrafts together with runways, aircraft maintenance space, passenger facilities and including aerodrome would come with the ambit of the term ‘Airport.’” The post AAI cannot unilaterally shut Airport multiplex; Madras HC orders National Policy Review by Centre appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Right to housing is a fundamental right’: Punjab and Haryana HC sets aside rejection of jhuggi dwellers’ claims under Small Flats Scheme, 2006
item.description: In the case at hand, the Chandigarh Housing Board rejected jhuggi dwellers’ claim for allotment of flat under the Chandigarh Small Flats Scheme, 2006 without giving them opportunity to be heard. The post ‘Right to housing is a fundamental right’: Punjab and Haryana HC sets aside rejection of jhuggi dwellers’ claims under Small Flats Scheme, 2006 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘In Honour Killing cases, bail is a carefully guarded exception’; Madras HC rejects bail in Kavin Honour Killing Case
item.description: “In grave offences like honour killing, bail is a carefully guarded exception, balancing liberty with justice and societal order. Judicial vigilance and societal awareness are crucial in eradicating the heinous crime.” The post ‘In Honour Killing cases, bail is a carefully guarded exception’; Madras HC rejects bail in Kavin Honour Killing Case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi High Court: Disputes arising after execution of settlement agreement remain arbitrable
item.description: “Execution of a full and final settlement may not preclude a party from taking recourse to arbitration if a dispute arises from the settlement itself” The post Delhi High Court: Disputes arising after execution of settlement agreement remain arbitrable appeared first on SCC Times.
